items.title: 美联储维持利率但释出12月评估窗口

facts.zh: FOMC 10 月会议维持 5.25%-5.50% 区间，同时在声明中加入“若通胀继续按预期降温，将在 12 月重新评估政策立场”的描述。点阵图显示 2026 年底前目标利率中位值下调 50bp。
facts.en: The October FOMC kept the target range at 5.25%-5.50% but added language that policymakers will reassess the stance in December if disinflation holds. The dot plot shifted lower by 50bp through end-2026.

impact_one_liner.zh: 短端收益率或在 11 月数据公布前保持高位震荡，资金将提前布局久期资产。
impact_one_liner.en: Short-end yields may stay range bound until November data, while duration assets see pre-positioning for an eventual pivot.

items.title: 美元走弱带动大宗商品反弹

facts.zh: 美元指数跌至 101.6，创四周新低。WTI 原油上涨 2.1% 至 86.4 美元/桶，COMEX 金价测试 2100 美元。基金数据显示 CTA 增持原油与黄金多单。
facts.en: The DXY slipped to 101.6, a four-week low. WTI crude gained 2.1% to $86.4/bbl and COMEX gold tested $2,100. CTA positioning points to renewed long exposure in both commodities.

impact_one_liner.zh: 能源与贵金属短线支撑增强，但需关注美元反弹或需求数据走弱的风险。
impact_one_liner.en: Energy and precious metals enjoy near-term support, though a dollar rebound or weaker demand data could cap gains.

items.title: 中国提出专项债额度调增方案

facts.zh: 国务院拟向全国人大常委会提请调增 2025 年地方政府专项债额度 1.5 万亿元，并将资金聚焦基建、保障性住房与绿色项目。政策要求项目资本金不低于 20%。
facts.en: China's State Council will seek NPC approval to raise the 2025 local government special bond quota by RMB 1.5 trillion, targeting infrastructure, affordable housing, and green projects with minimum 20% equity contributions.

impact_one_liner.zh: 基建与城投融资环境有望改善，信用利差或阶段性收窄，但需跟踪后续资金调配节奏。
impact_one_liner.en: Infrastructure and LGFV financing conditions should ease, narrowing credit spreads, though execution pace remains a key watchpoint.

items.title: 欧元区 PMI 预览指向制造业触底

facts.zh: 10 月欧元区制造业 PMI 初值升至 49.1，为 18 个月新高；服务业 PMI 回升至 51.3。企业成本压力进一步回落，企业对未来 12 个月预期走强。
facts.en: Eurozone October flash manufacturing PMI rose to 49.1, an 18-month high, while services PMI recovered to 51.3. Input cost pressures eased further and 12-month expectations improved.

impact_one_liner.zh: 若后续数据验证企稳，欧洲央行可以维持观望期并减轻衰退担忧。
impact_one_liner.en: If confirmed by hard data, the ECB can extend its pause while recession fears ease.

items.title: 日本央行微调收益率曲线控制

facts.zh: 日银将 10 年国债收益率的参考上限从 1.5% 上调至 1.75%，并宣布加大国债购买的灵活性，以缓解长期利率上行压力。
facts.en: The BOJ lifted the reference ceiling on 10-year JGB yields to 1.75% and pledged more flexible bond purchases to smooth long-end volatility.

impact_one_liner.zh: 日元短线走强，但全球利差仍限制进一步升值；亚洲债市需关注收益率联动。
impact_one_liner.en: The yen receives near-term support though global rate differentials cap upside; Asian bonds may see spillover volatility.
